name: Nagise Tsukiko
source:
A young woman who approaches the Ayana Detective Agency for protection against a serial killer.

[spoiler]Tsukiko is a psychic. She claims that she has the power of psychometry (the ability to determine an object's history through physical contact), but this turns out to be a lie; her true ability is chronokinesis (the ability to manipulate the past), the same ability as [url=https://vndb.org/c124913]Kyosuke[/url]. She is also the murderer herself, and is planning to also kill Evsej Amabishi as revenge for the human experimentation she suffered in the past.[/spoiler]
